selection: All remaining four paired records in the pinned trace directory after excluding the four previously used records. For each use the first chronological complete32s window at offset0. If common directional horizon<32000ms, retain exclusion without replacement/cycling/scaling/performance screening. Numerical content acquired only after this freeze.
rotation: Rotate all ten method/penalty rows by round index; exact same full32s task each round. Round0 scientific performance; rounds1/2 timing repeats, not independent trials. No cache reuse across sessions.
task: Unchanged nonlinear30s UAV trajectory plus2s registration,0.5m position and0.8s age,per-source loss<=.15. Existing quality enclosure reused; no model or service threshold tuning.
identity: Final remaining-obligation guard for every remote row. Same full-horizon Hatami/Yang adapters and all frozen penalties as predecessor. FixedLocal retains source-local quality/checks and original blanket ACK deferral.
cost: Primary session CPU includes coordinator initialization, full-horizon request planning, observer, grant/ACK guard, codec, local checks, paid-quality operations, logging and UDP IPC plus active CPU of all three endpoints. Separately report full cold-process-stack CPU including endpoint interpreter imports and spawn setup; startup is not hidden. Remove timed in-loop independent containment/truth-metric evaluation; independent post-run audits and offline trajectory/enclosure excluded. Runtime code loading remains included as conservative harness overhead, not claimed production cost. Three rotated rounds; report per-context median and median of stratum pooled round means, with all round ranges. Outer UDP transport bill separately from contract bytes. Per-event wall delays include IPC; logical-time service is not real-time execution.
decision: Primary paired gates: both feasible, no worse loss for either source, no fewer deliveries. Report inner/outer bytes, full-stack CPU, latency and all adverse outcomes. Pareto fronts use both per-source losses, negative complete deliveries, inner bytes and full-stack CPU; outer bytes additionally reported. No post-hoc best price selection.
prospective: Test the prior1280B/s scalar-vs-exact strata without reselecting: report all task gates, all-window mean byte/CPU tradeoffs and worst cases. New full-stack valuations are descriptive, not a guaranteed future selector. A useful byte/CPU tradeoff requires task gate and positive saving; no energy conversion.
failure: Archive every exception/event trace, stop on scientific or integration failure. No silent retry with altered code. Repairs require preserving frozen code and explicit revision evidence; exposed traces cease being new independent confirmation for method changes.
package_scope: Manuscript and derived figure/table inputs. Full runtime and raw logs remain in the original experiment project.

evidence_chain.scope: Existing recorded evidence, summarized for the TVT manuscript; no new experiment execution.
evidence_chain.rejection_scope: The final Exact streams contain no rejected ACK guard calls. The rejection-debt-execution-readmission witness belongs to the separate mechanism diagnostic and is not counted as independent confirmation.
